{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the data dictionary instruction: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_clean = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now count the number of unique patients after filtering
total_enrolled = len(df_clean)

# Check that this matches the number of unique patient_id values in the cleaned data
total_enrolled, df_clean['patient_id'].nunique()"}
